data.title: Bliss 2
data.about:
Whitewashed townhouses with cobbled streets and winding paths, Bliss at Arabian Ranches III is truly a one of kind project. Your contemporary and minimalist style townhouses offers space, privacy, and a host of lifestyle amenities and activities nearby. 

These modern townhouses are nestled in generous plots and are just a stone’s throw from ARIII Central Park and the souk. Enjoy in your private courtyard or access a host of amenities nearby. Sports facilities, bicycle trails, and meandering walking pathways await. Or enjoy the signature clubhouse, gym, and pool and take time out for leisurely family dining and shopping.

characteristics_module.title: Dubai's First Urban Village
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Emaar’s First-Ever Urban Village in Arabian Ranches III
  • 3 and 4 BR Townhouses Inspired By Homes In Santorini Greece
  • 3 BR starting at AED 1.84 Million
  • 3-BR Townhouse size ranging from: 2,211 – 2,179 sq.ft.
  • 4-BR Townhouse size ranging from: 3,243 – 3,071 sq.ft.
  • Whitewashed townhouses with cobbled streets
  • Pedestrian friendly neighbourhood
  • Private courtyard with a wide range of amenities
  • More open spaces than any other cluster ever launched in AR III
  • The 2nd Souk of ARIII, Club House with Swimming Pool
  • Vibrant community with plenty of sports and outdoor recreation facilities
  • Nearby Metro, schools, clinics, retail, dining, and entertainment

location_tile.title: Close to Arabian Ranches 1 & 2
location_tile.description:
Located in the central area of Dubai, Arabian Ranches 3 is one of the most prestigious addresses in Dubai. Live in a flawlessly designed neighbourhood that is centred around your family’s balance and well-being.  Come home to tranquillity where your spaciously appointed home lies in the heart of a gated community just steps away from the Arabian Ranches III Central Park and a host of amenities. Arabian Ranches is a success story that is hallmarked by its attention to detail as a preferential gated community served by premium facilities.

  • 05 mins – Global Village
  • 10 mins – Polo Equestrian Club
  • 20 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 20 mins – Dubai International Airport
